items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
items.detail:
美國運通（American Express）於2026年10月13日正式推出「意圖智能框架」（Intent Intelligence Framework），作為其4月發布的 ACE（Agentic Commerce Experiences）開發工具套件的核心安全層。此舉旨在系統性應對大型語言模型固有的「非確定性行為」所帶來的商業交易風險——AI代理可能在執行任務過程中偏離用戶原意，例如在用戶指定購買Nike球鞋時，代理卻下單了Adidas。

該框架採用四步驟機制運作。首先，「意圖建立API」（Create Intent API）記錄用戶的購買指令，包含商家名稱、預算上限及商品偏好等約束條件；其次，用戶通過身份驗證確認所授權的意圖；第三步生成唯一的意圖識別碼（Intent ID）及意圖證明令牌（Proof of Intent Token）；最後，系統於結帳環節以安全數字支付憑證取代實體卡號，全程不暴露真實帳戶資訊。

美國運通副總裁 Hannah Bozian 解釋，這套設計的關鍵在於「將意圖捕獲提前至交易流程的更早期」，從而在資金流出前就攔截偏差行為。與其他事後爭議處理機制相比，此框架屬於主動防禦性架構，而非被動補救。Bozian 亦明確表示，目前代理商業所帶來的爭議申訴量尚未見明顯上升，現階段措施具有預防性質。

美國運通的 Trendex 消費者調查數據顯示，未來12個月內，66%的美國消費者可能使用AI代理進行比價研究，61%可能用於商品推薦。這一消費者信心基礎使美國運通認為，代理商業即將快速普及，提前建立授權標準至關重要。美國運通表示，希望此框架能成為整個行業處理AI驅動交易的通用標準，並已向開發者開放 ACE 工具套件接入。
items.detail_en:
American Express officially launched its 'Intent Intelligence Framework' on October 13, 2026, as the security core of its ACE (Agentic Commerce Experiences) Developer Toolkit, which was first introduced in April 2026. The initiative directly addresses the nondeterministic behavior inherent in large language models — a risk where AI agents can deviate from user instructions during task execution, such as purchasing Adidas shoes when Nike was specified.

The framework operates through a four-step mechanism. First, the Create Intent API captures the user's purchase instructions along with defined constraints — merchant name, budget ceiling, and product preferences. The user then authenticates and approves the captured intent. The system then generates a unique Intent ID and a Proof of Intent Token. Finally, at checkout, a secure digital payment credential replaces the actual card number, ensuring the real account is never exposed.

Amex VP Hannah Bozian explained that the key design principle is to 'pull intent earlier into the transaction flow,' intercepting deviations before funds move rather than managing disputes afterward. Unlike reactive chargeback mechanisms, this framework is architecturally proactive. Bozian also noted that dispute volume from agentic commerce has not yet risen noticeably — making the current rollout a preventive measure rather than a crisis response.

Amex's Trendex consumer survey found that within the next 12 months, 66% of U.S. consumers are likely to use AI agents for price research and 61% for product recommendations. This consumer appetite signals that agentic commerce is approaching rapid mainstream adoption, making pre-emptive authorization standards strategically important. American Express has stated its intent to position the framework as an industry-wide standard for AI-powered transactions, with the ACE toolkit now open to developers.

items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
items.detail:
阿里巴巴於2026年10月13日在旗下千問（Qwen）App 內正式推出「千問 Go」，這是一款搭載 Qwen 3.8 Agentic 模型的個人AI代理產品，能夠自主完成跨平台的複雜現實任務，而非僅限於回答問題或生成文本。

官方公布的實測案例具體呈現了這款代理的能力邊界。在一起航班延誤理賠案例中，用戶本身已忘記航班訂單資訊，千問 Go 自動登入相關平台查詢歷史訂單，隨後主動聯繫人工客服，並最終將平台最初提供的70元代金券談判成等值現金賠償。在電商價保場景中，代理成功為用戶申請到52元退款。其他已驗證的使用場景包括：完成汽車保養預約（含事先詢價環節）、按用戶時間偏好預訂羽毛球場地，以及綜合計算補貼、優惠券及舊機回收折扣後進行購物比價。

千問 Go 的核心競爭優勢在於其生態縱深。由於阿里系涵蓋淘寶、飛猬（Fliggy/飛豬）、高德地圖等多個高頻消費平台，千問 Go 對這些平台的介面、流程與授權機制具備深度原生理解，遇到障礙時會主動尋找替代路徑，而非直接回報失敗——這與通用型代理相比具有明顯的體驗差異。

此次發布所處的行業背景競爭激烈：Meta 於9月9日發布了 Muse 個人助手；OpenAI 在其 DevDay 上推出了 Dots Agent 產品線；初創公司 Instinct 則完成了由紅杉資本領投、金額達10億美元的 C 輪融資，估值達100億美元。個人AI代理正從演示走向實際部署，阿里此舉標誌著中國本土的消費級代理競爭正式進入白熱化階段。
items.detail_en:
Alibaba officially launched 'Qwen Go' on October 13, 2026, within its Qwen app — a personal AI agent powered by the Qwen 3.8 Agentic model. Unlike conventional AI assistants limited to answering questions or generating text, Qwen Go autonomously executes complex, real-world tasks across multiple platforms.

Officially demonstrated use cases illustrate the agent's operational range. In one flight-delay compensation scenario, the user had forgotten their own booking details — Qwen Go independently logged into the relevant platform to retrieve historical orders, contacted human customer service, and ultimately negotiated a platform's initial offer of a 70-yuan voucher into an equivalent cash payment. In an e-commerce price-protection case, the agent successfully applied for a 52-yuan refund. Other verified scenarios include completing a car maintenance booking after price-checking, reserving a badminton court based on user time preferences, and conducting shopping comparisons by factoring in subsidies, coupons, and trade-in discounts.

Qwen Go's core competitive advantage lies in ecosystem depth. Because Alibaba's platform portfolio encompasses Taobao, Fliggy (Feizhu), Gaode Maps, and other high-frequency consumer services, Qwen Go has deep native familiarity with their interfaces, workflows, and authorization layers. When encountering obstacles, it proactively seeks alternative paths rather than reporting failure — a meaningful experience difference compared to general-purpose agents.

The release arrives in an intensely competitive landscape. Meta launched its Muse personal assistant on September 9; OpenAI introduced its Dots Agent product line at DevDay; and startup Instinct closed a $1 billion Series C led by Sequoia Capital at a $10 billion valuation. Personal AI agents are moving from demo to deployment, and Alibaba's launch signals that China's consumer-grade agent race has entered a full sprint.

items.detail:
Meta 的企業級人工智能平台佈局正在快速成型，其核心產品 Muse 已從個人助手延伸至企業服務領域，並整合了電腦使用（computer use）能力。為主導這一轉型，Meta 特別聘用前 MongoDB 執行長 CJ Desai 出任企業平台負責人，目標是將服務範圍擴展至廣告工具以外的業務場景。

現有產品線涵蓋「Muse for Small Business」（整合 Box、Figma 及 Shopify 等工具）、Muse Code 開發助手，以及透過 MCP（Model Context Protocol）伺服器將 AI 代理連接至廣告管理工具的 Meta Business Agent。市場定位上，Meta 將 Muse 描述為對廣告主而言具有「超越市場上其他代理」的電腦使用能力，並以已熟悉 Meta Ads 的中小企業為主要切入點。

然而，企業客戶與代理商對此抱持明顯顧慮。數位行銷機構 Hawke Media 創辦人 Jeremy Schulkin 直言：「我們一直在努力，就是為了不把鑰匙交給 Meta。」核心疑慮有三：其一，Muse 目前僅提供雲端版本，企業數據須上傳至 Meta 伺服器，受到金融、醫療等高度監管行業的合規制約，Arkose Labs 執行長 Kevin Gosschalk 亦指出「Muse 目前是雲端服務」的現實限制；其二，由於 Meta 同時經營廣告業務，批評者擔憂平台存在利益衝突，質疑 Muse 能否在廣告建議中客觀推薦競爭對手，例如 TikTok；其三，市場研究機構 Forrester 分析師 Kate Winick 指出，即便功能成熟，「也不能保證他們拿下訂單」，因為企業採購決策遠比功能評估複雜。

對於已熟悉 Ads Manager 進階功能的資深廣告從業者而言，現階段 Muse 被評為「缺乏足夠的精密度」。Meta 企業平台整體仍處於初期階段，定價細節與分層存取方案均未公開披露，市場能否接受一家廣告巨頭兼任企業生產力工具供應商，仍是這場佈局最大的未知變數。
items.detail_en:
Meta's enterprise AI platform ambitions are accelerating, with Muse expanding from a personal assistant into enterprise services with computer use capabilities. To lead this push, Meta hired former MongoDB CEO CJ Desai to head its enterprise platform, with a mandate to extend offerings well beyond advertising tools.

The current product lineup includes Muse for Small Business — integrating with Box, Figma, and Shopify — Muse Code for developers, and Meta Business Agent, which uses a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server to connect AI agents to advertising management tools. Meta positions Muse as having computer use capabilities that surpass other agents on the market, targeting small and medium businesses already familiar with Meta Ads as its primary entry point.

Enterprise clients and agencies have expressed clear reservations. Jeremy Schulkin, founder of digital marketing agency Hawke Media, stated bluntly: 'We have fought hard to not hand over the keys to Meta.' Three concerns dominate. First, Muse is cloud-only — enterprise data must flow into Meta's servers, creating compliance barriers for regulated industries like finance and healthcare, a limitation Kevin Gosschalk of Arkose Labs acknowledged directly. Second, critics worry about conflicts of interest given Meta's core ads business, questioning whether Muse would ever objectively recommend competitors like TikTok in ad strategy advice. Third, Forrester analyst Kate Winick cautioned that even with strong features, 'it's not going to guarantee them the sale,' as enterprise procurement involves far more than feature comparison.

For seasoned advertisers already proficient in Ads Manager, Muse is currently assessed as lacking the sophistication required for advanced use cases. Meta's enterprise platform remains early-stage — no pricing details or tiered access structures have been disclosed — and the market's willingness to accept a major ad platform as a neutral enterprise productivity vendor remains the biggest open question in this strategic bet.

items.title: 法官裁令 OpenAI 交出招募紀錄，Apple 商業機密案加速推進
items.title_en: Judge Orders OpenAI to Hand Over Hiring Records in Apple Trade Secrets Case
items.summary: 法院批准 Apple 就前員工跳槽 OpenAI 取得緊急證據，大模型公司法律風險升溫
items.summary_en: A US judge granted Apple expedited access to OpenAI hiring materials and messages in a trade secrets lawsuit, alleging former Apple employees brought confidential hardware and robotics files to OpenAI interviews.

items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
items.detail:
加州北區聯邦地區法院法官 Edward Davila 於2026年10月13日裁定，要求 OpenAI 在裁定後5至14天內向蘋果公司（Apple）提交涉案的招募紀錄及相關內部文件，此案源自蘋果於同年7月對 OpenAI 提起的商業機密竊取訴訟。

蘋果的核心指控是一種系統性行為模式：多名前蘋果工程師在離職加入 OpenAI 前，曾利用公司發放的 Apple 筆記型電腦下載涉及「未公告技術、功能及產品」的機密文件，部分人員甚至被指協助指導其他候選人，告知面試 OpenAI 時應帶走哪些資料。此案背景與 OpenAI 傳聞中首款消費者硬件設備的開發計劃密切相關。

法官批准的強制披露範圍相當具體：涵蓋 OpenAI 面試前蘋果員工時使用的所有面試材料（聚焦於消費者硬件及機器人領域職位），包括核查清單、流程指南、腳本、技術演示及任何提及蘋果技術的內部文件；此外還包括 OpenAI 員工 Chang Liu 與 Alyssa Peng 之間的私人 LINE 通訊記錄，以及對 Liu、Peng 及 OpenAI 首席硬件官 Tang Yew Tan（三人均為前蘋果員工）的書面證詞。

與此同時，法官拒絕了蘋果更廣泛的取證申請，包括針對 OpenAI 在金屬表面處理及電源管理等研發領域的調查，以及對前員工在 OpenAI 所創作成果的全面取證。法官允許蘋果日後就上述議題提出範圍更窄的補充申請。此案進展將是今後幾個月內科技業知識產權爭議中最受關注的司法動態之一。
items.detail_en:
U.S. District Judge Edward Davila of the Northern District of California ruled on October 13, 2026, ordering OpenAI to produce relevant hiring records and internal documents to Apple within 5 to 14 days of the order. The case originates from a trade secrets lawsuit Apple filed against OpenAI in July 2026.

Apple's core allegation describes a systematic pattern of behavior: multiple former Apple engineers used company-issued Apple laptops to download confidential files containing 'unannounced technologies, features, and products' before leaving to join OpenAI. Some individuals are alleged to have coached others on what materials to bring to OpenAI interviews. The case is closely tied to OpenAI's rumored development of its first consumer hardware device.

The court-ordered discovery is precisely scoped. It covers all interview materials OpenAI used when interviewing former Apple employees for roles in consumer hardware and robotics — including checklists, procedural guides, scripts, technical presentations, and any documents referencing Apple technology. The order also covers private LINE messages between OpenAI employees Chang Liu and Alyssa Peng, plus depositions of Liu, Peng, and OpenAI's chief hardware officer Tang Yew Tan — all former Apple employees. Already-collected materials must be produced within 5 days; remaining materials within 14 days.

The judge denied Apple's broader discovery requests, including expedited access to OpenAI's R&D in areas such as metal finishes and power management, and broader investigation into what former employees created at OpenAI. Apple retains the right to refile narrower requests on those topics. The case's trajectory will be among the most closely watched intellectual property disputes in the technology sector over the coming months.

items.summary_en: Pluto Security raised $42M to help enterprises monitor and control employee AI usage — including MCP servers and vibe-coded apps — with 60% of detected risks originating from non-developer staff like finance teams.
items.why: AI 工具氾濫帶來合規風險，代理商須為客戶建立 AI 使用規範
items.why_en: Proliferating AI tools create compliance and data risks; agencies need governance policies to protect client work.
highlights: Pluto Security 能即時介入 AI 代理對話，在代理超越授權範圍時注入上下文以改變其行為。
公司自 2026 年 4 月才開始銷售，已累積逾 30 家企業客戶，年度經常性收入超過 200 萬美元。
約六成已偵測風險來自財務等非開發人員部門，反映 AI 工具普及化已遠超 IT 管控範圍。
highlights_en: Pluto Security can intervene in real time within AI agent sessions, injecting context to change agent behavior when it exceeds intended permissions.
Despite only starting sales in April 2026, the company has 30+ enterprise customers and surpassed $2M ARR.
Roughly 60% of detected risks originate from non-developer employees — with finance as the largest source — showing AI tool adoption has outpaced IT oversight.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
items.detail:
企業AI安全新創 Pluto Security 於2026年10月宣布完成兩輪合計4,200萬美元的融資：由 TLV Partners 領投（Armis 聯合創辦人亦參與投資）的850萬美元種子輪，以及由 Jump Capital 領投、Skinos、Ansa Capital 及多位天使投資人共同參與的3,400萬美元 A 輪。公司自2026年4月上線以來，已實現逾200萬美元年度經常性收入，現有企業客戶超過30家，包括 Oscar Health、Workato、Sixt 及 AlphaSense。

Pluto Security 所應對的核心問題，是企業內部 AI 工具擴散的速度遠超安全管控能力。根據公司的實測觀察，一款新發布的 AI 工具可在上線後僅兩小時內滲入企業環境。更關鍵的是，最大的風險來源並非技術開發人員，而是非技術員工：財務部門位居風險製造者首位，其次是行銷與法務部門，開發人員僅排第四。這一發現顛覆了業界長期以來「安全漏洞主要源自技術人員」的慣性認知，也正是標題所指「六成風險來自非技術員工」的實證基礎。

產品層面，Pluto 平台對 AI 工具、瀏覽器擴充功能、MCP 伺服器、代理行為及「氛圍編碼」（vibe-coded）應用程式進行即時監控，並可主動介入——例如當某個代理嘗試申請超出授權範圍的權限時，Pluto 可暫停該操作，或向當前會話注入背景資訊以觸發用戶確認。公司另推出免費社群工具「Plutonium」，供安全從業者掃描公開可用的 AI 技能與連接器，目前已有數千名安全專業人員使用。

Pluto 回報了一項引人注目的實地發現：在其迄今為止進行的每一次概念驗證測試中，均發現了惡意活動，其中部分案例已存在正在進行中的主動攻擊。70%的銷售管線來自市場自發的入站詢問，顯示企業對 AI 治理工具的需求正從被動合規轉向主動尋購。公司目前在美國和以色列共有40名員工。
items.detail_en:
Enterprise AI security startup Pluto Security announced in October 2026 the completion of two funding rounds totaling $42 million: an $8.5 million seed round led by TLV Partners (with Armis co-founders investing) and a $34 million Series A led by Jump Capital, with participation from Skinos, Ansa Capital, and several angels. Since launching in April 2026, the company has surpassed $2 million in ARR and serves more than 30 enterprise customers including Oscar Health, Workato, Sixt, and AlphaSense.

The core problem Pluto addresses is that AI tools spread through enterprise environments far faster than security controls can track. The company's field observations show that a newly released AI tool can appear inside a corporate environment within just two hours of public launch. More significantly, the highest-risk actors are not technical developers — finance teams create the most exposure, followed by marketing and legal departments, with developers ranking fourth. This finding directly challenges the industry assumption that security gaps are primarily a developer problem.

At the product level, the Pluto platform monitors AI tools, browser extensions, MCP servers, agent behaviors, and vibe-coded applications in real time. It can actively intervene: when an agent seeks permissions beyond its authorized scope, Pluto can halt the action or inject context back into the session to prompt user confirmation. The company also launched Plutonium, a free community tool for scanning publicly available AI skills and connectors, now used by thousands of security professionals.

Pluto reported a striking field finding: in every proof-of-concept engagement conducted to date, the team discovered malicious activity — including cases with live, active attacks already underway at the time of discovery. The fact that 70% of its sales pipeline comes from inbound interest signals that enterprise demand for AI governance tools is shifting from passive compliance to active procurement. The company currently employs 40 people across the United States and Israel.

items.title: 蘋果 iOS 27 直接封鎖 The Trade Desk Safari 廣告，程序化損失加速計算
items.title_en: Apple iOS 27 Directly Blocks The Trade Desk from Safari Ads as Programmatic Losses Mount
items.summary: iOS 27 將 The Trade Desk Cookie 域名列入 Safari 封鎖清單，業界損失計算加速
items.summary_en: Apple's iOS 27 has specifically blocked The Trade Desk's cookie domain in Safari, with the industry now calculating escalating losses as hundreds of programmatic data companies face similar blocks.
items.why: 依賴 The Trade Desk 的 iOS 受眾策略需即時調整，第一方數據替代方案刻不容緩
items.why_en: Programmatic strategies relying on The Trade Desk for iOS audiences need urgent reassessment; first-party data alternatives are now critical.
highlights: iOS 27 將 The Trade Desk 的 Cookie 域名加入 Safari 封鎖清單，直接影響覆蓋 Apple 裝置的程序化廣告活動。
業界初步估算 eCPM 首週跌逾一成，且損失範圍已擴展至數百家程序化數據公司，影響遠超市場初期預期。
此舉加速無 Cookie 時代到來，代理商需盡快部署情境定向與第一方數據替代方案以維持受眾覆蓋。
highlights_en: iOS 27 added The Trade Desk's cookie domain to Safari's blocklist, directly affecting programmatic campaigns targeting Apple device users via that DSP.
Industry estimates show eCPM falling over 10% in the first week, with losses now extending to hundreds of additional programmatic data companies.
The move accelerates the cookieless transition; agencies must deploy contextual targeting and first-party data alternatives urgently to maintain audience reach.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
items.followup: 10 月 13 日我們報過蘋果 Safari 封鎖廣告追蹤導致 eCPM 首週跌逾一成，以及 iOS 27 廣告封鎖範圍擴至數百家程序化數據供應商。今日新發展是 The Trade Desk 的 Cookie 域名已被明確列入封鎖清單，標誌 Apple 的打擊對象已由泛性追蹤技術升級至點名主要 DSP 平台，代理商程序化買量策略面臨的結構性衝擊比前一日預估更為直接。
items.followup_en: On Oct 13 we reported Safari's tracking block causing eCPM to fall over 10% in week one, and iOS 27 expanding blocks to hundreds of programmatic data vendors. Today's new development: The Trade Desk's cookie domain is now specifically named on the blocklist, escalating Apple's targeting from generic tracking tech to a leading DSP by name — the structural impact on agency programmatic buying is more direct than yesterday's picture suggested.
items.detail:
蘋果於2026年9月14日正式推出iOS 27，然而隨之而來的，是程序化廣告生態系統的一場震盪。蘋果的WebKit引擎在此次更新中擴大了「無條件封鎖」名單的範疇，將從事跨網站用戶追蹤及可定址ID比對的數據供應商域名列入阻擋清單。被封鎖的對象除了The Trade Desk的身份識別解決方案UIDAPI.com外，還涵蓋ID5、Audigent、LiveRamp及Permutive等業者，波及整個獨立廣告技術陣營。

問題的核心在於，蘋果這次封鎖的不僅是身份識別層，更直接切斷了The Trade Desk的廣告投遞基礎設施。The Trade Desk資深工程總監Ian Meyers在WebKit的公開問題追蹤系統Bugzilla提交了緊急工單，編號#324771，明確指出「adsrvr.org是The Trade Desk的核心廣告請求與投遞域名，並非身份識別用途」。adsrvr.org遭到封鎖，意味著在已升級至iOS 27的裝置上，The Trade Desk完全無法在Safari瀏覽器中競標及投放廣告，而非僅喪失用戶追蹤能力。

此事件的深層爭議，在於競爭公平性的質疑。Meyers在工單中附上了在yahoo.com非私密瀏覽模式下的測試截圖，顯示The Trade Desk的競標請求遭到封鎖，而Google的廣告請求（經由ad.doubleclick.net發出）卻得以順利通過。這一發現引發了業界廣泛討論——蘋果的封鎖機制是否存在選擇性執法的問題，從而在結構上有利於Google在Safari廣告市場的地位。蘋果WebKit隱私與廣告技術部門的負責人John Wilander雖已確認收到工單，回覆稱「若有任何可供測試的變更，將會通知您」，卻未提供任何時程承諾。

截至AdExchanger於9月29日報道時，事件懸而未決。業界對此出現兩種推測：其一，adsrvr.org被納入封鎖名單屬於技術誤判，蘋果審查後可能予以恢復；其二，蘋果有意將封鎖範圍從身份識別域名擴展至廣告投遞基礎設施本身。若為後者，iOS 27設備上的Safari將對The Trade Desk等獨立DSP關閉大門。此時恰逢紐約廣告週期間，整個程序化廣告圈「如同被翻倒蜂巢裡的居民般嗡嗡作響」。Apple及The Trade Desk均未在截稿前回應AdExchanger的置評請求。
items.detail_en:
Apple released iOS 27 on September 14, 2026, triggering a significant disruption across the programmatic advertising ecosystem. The update expanded WebKit's existing policy of unconditionally blocking domains engaged in cross-site user tracking and addressable ID matching. The blocklist sweep caught not only The Trade Desk's identity solution UIDAPI.com, but also ID5, Audigent, LiveRamp, and Permutive — effectively targeting the entire independent ad tech identity layer.

The deeper problem is that Apple's block extended beyond identity infrastructure to The Trade Desk's core ad serving capabilities. Ian Meyers, The Trade Desk's Senior Director of Engineering, filed an urgent ticket on WebKit's public Bugzilla tracker (Bug #324771), explicitly stating: 'Adsrvr.org is The Trade Desk's core ad request and delivery domain, not identity.' With adsrvr.org blocked, The Trade Desk cannot bid or serve ads on Safari on iOS 27 devices at all — a far more severe consequence than losing tracking capability alone.

The episode raised pointed competitive fairness questions. Meyers included a screenshot in his bug report showing that on a yahoo.com non-private browsing session, The Trade Desk bids were blocked while Google's bids via ad.doubleclick.net passed through without interference. This asymmetry drew immediate industry scrutiny over whether Apple's enforcement selectively disadvantages independent DSPs while leaving Google's infrastructure intact on Safari. Apple's Manager of WebKit Privacy and Ad Tech, John Wilander, acknowledged the ticket, responding that he would 'let you know if and when any changes are available for you to test,' with no timeline offered.

As of AdExchanger's September 29 report, two scenarios remained in play: the block on adsrvr.org was an inadvertent error that Apple would correct upon review, or Apple was deliberately extending its blocklist from identity domains to ad delivery infrastructure itself — which would effectively shut independent DSPs out of Safari on iOS 27 devices entirely. The story broke during Advertising Week New York, with the programmatic industry described as 'buzzing madly like the inhabitants of an overturned beehive.' Neither Apple nor The Trade Desk responded to requests for comment before publication.

items.title: 亞馬遜將 DSP 與廣告控制台合併，重塑為代理式 AI「Ads Agent」
items.title_en: Amazon Merges DSP and Ads Console into Agentic 'Ads Agent', Reducing Manual Touchpoints
items.summary: 亞馬遜以代理式 AI 統一廣告買量，代理商手動操作空間進一步收窄
items.summary_en: Amazon merged its DSP and Ads Console into a single AI-driven 'Ads Agent', positioning autonomous optimization at the center of its ad-buying experience and reducing manual intervention for agencies.
items.why: 亞馬遜程序化廣告操作模式根本轉變，代理商需重新評估服務範疇
items.why_en: Amazon's programmatic model shifts fundamentally; agencies must reassess their service scope and value-add.
highlights: 亞馬遜將原本分開的 DSP 與廣告控制台整合為統一介面，以代理式 AI 統一管理廣告活動。
新產品以 AI 自主執行優化決策為核心，顯著減少廣告主與代理商的人工介入步驟。
此舉與 The Trade Desk 等同業的 AI 轉型競爭直接相關，加速零售媒體廣告的自動化進程。
highlights_en: Amazon merged its previously separate DSP and Ads Console into a unified interface centered on agentic AI campaign management.
The new 'Ads Agent' positions autonomous AI optimization at the core, significantly reducing manual steps for advertisers and agencies.
The rebrand directly competes with The Trade Desk's AI-driven evolution, accelerating automation across retail media advertising.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
items.followup: 10 月 9 日我們報過亞馬遜 CTV 與 DSP 廣告支出在 Prime Big Deal Days 前錄得最高四成增幅。今日是結構性升級：亞馬遜正式將 DSP 與廣告控制台合併為代理式 AI 平台「Ads Agent」，從量的增長轉向自動化決策架構——代理商的人工操盤空間由此進一步收窄，需重新定位服務差異化。
items.followup_en: On Oct 9 we reported Amazon CTV and DSP ad spend growing up to 40% ahead of Prime Big Deal Days — a volume story. Today is the structural shift: Amazon officially merged its DSP and Ads Console into an agentic AI platform called 'Ads Agent', moving from spend growth to automated decision-making architecture. The implication for agencies: manual optimization space narrows further, making service differentiation the new pitch.

items.title: 代理商爭相採用合成受眾，策略簡報周期從 30 天壓縮至三天
items.title_en: Agencies Race to Adopt Synthetic Audiences, Cutting Strategy Brief Timelines from 30 Days to Three
items.summary: WPP、電通等大型代理商以 AI 模擬消費者數據取代傳統調研，惟底層數據質量至關重要
items.summary_en: Major agencies including WPP and Dentsu are replacing traditional research with AI-simulated consumer data, compressing strategy brief timelines from 30 days to three days, though data quality concerns persist.
items.why: AI 調研大幅壓縮前期策劃周期，這條技能線值得立即評估
items.why_en: AI-simulated research dramatically cuts pre-campaign planning time — a capability worth evaluating immediately.
highlights: Goodway Group 與 Arima 合作，在真實投放前以合成美、英、德消費者族群進行增量測試。
Magnum、Vans 及 Kenvue 使用 Vurvey Labs 的合成受眾，將策略簡報時間從 30 天縮短至三天。
TransUnion 提醒，若底層數據質量不佳，合成模型將放大偏差，需嚴格把關數據源頭。
highlights_en: Goodway Group partnered with Arima to run incrementality tests against simulated US, UK, and German consumer populations before real-world activation.
Magnum, Vans, and Kenvue used Vurvey Labs' synthetic personas, cutting strategy brief timelines from 30 days to three days.
TransUnion cautioned that poor-quality source data will compound errors at scale in synthetic models, urging rigorous vetting.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
items.detail:
合成受眾技術在2026年下半年迎來加速普及的轉折點，多家大型代理商與品牌客戶已從實驗性採用走向系統化部署。推動這一轉變的核心驅動力，是策略研究周期的大幅壓縮：以強生旗下的Aveeno身體護膚線為例，透過Vurvey Labs的Freckle工具，一份消費者策略簡報的產出周期從原本的30天縮減至三天，直接加速了Aveeno Sensitive Skin Scents系列於2026年初的上市進程。聯合利華的Magnum冰淇淋及VF Corporation旗下的Vans也採用了相同的工具鏈用於產品開發決策。

Goodway Group自2026年8月起與統計建模公司Arima展開合作，將人口普查局數據、勞工統計局數據、尼爾森資料及客戶第一方數據融合，構建合成受眾用於增量測試與媒體投放模擬。Goodway同時也透過Optable建立合成受眾人物誌，探索將這項技術應用到定價策略與分銷渠道決策等超越媒體採購的領域。Goodway的執行副總裁Frampton-Calero說明了這項技術的核心價值：「若我們在不同層級上進行投放……會發生什麼？針對合成受眾，我們可以對此進行模擬。」這種模擬能力在區域市場或特定產品線等研究數據「通常相當有限」的情境中尤具價值。

美容品牌Sacheu透過Limitless Labs，以TikTok與Instagram創作者的貼文內容建立虛擬焦點小組，測試不同的行銷訊息組合。Havas於2025年11月完成對Vurvey Labs的8.5百萬美元A輪融資跟投，Dentsu則與Evidenza維持超過一年的合作關係用於媒體規劃，WPP更利用公益捐款數據驅動程序化媒體採購，而Jellyfish與Code & Theory透過Adobe的合作夥伴關係，將客戶第一方數據結合第三方數據生成創意人物誌，應用於從提案到製作的全流程。

然而，業界對合成受眾的局限性也保持著清醒的認知。Goodway的Reynolds明確指出，大型語言模型傾向於給出「鐘型分佈頂端」的答案，即最常見的回應，因此容易遺漏邊緣消費者洞察——Vurvey與純粹LLM方案的差異，正在於它攝入了真實消費者的定性影片問卷數據。Goodway的另一名主管Hoffman強調，合成工具「提供判斷依據，卻無法取代判斷本身」；Code & Theory的Clark則警告，以垃圾般的非專屬數據構建的合成人物誌同樣輸出垃圾，更點名代理式採購存在在單一天內耗盡預算的集中化風險。整體而言，業界的共識正從「是否採用」轉向「如何設計可靠的數據基礎」。
items.detail_en:
Synthetic audience technology reached an inflection point in the second half of 2026, with several major agencies and brand clients moving from experimental trials to systematic deployment. The central catalyst is a dramatic compression of strategy research cycles: for Johnson & Johnson's Aveeno body care line, using Vurvey Labs' Freckle tool, a consumer strategy brief that previously took 30 days now takes three — a timeline that directly accelerated the launch of the Aveeno Sensitive Skin Scents range earlier in 2026. Unilever's Magnum and VF Corporation's Vans brand have adopted the same toolchain for product development decisions.

Goodway Group formalized a partnership with statistical modeling firm Arima in August 2026, blending US Census Bureau data, Bureau of Labor Statistics data, Nielsen data, and client first-party data to build synthetic audiences for incrementality testing and media spend simulation. Goodway is simultaneously building synthetic audience personas through Optable and is exploring extending the technology into pricing strategy and distribution channel decisions — well beyond media buying. Goodway EVP Frampton-Calero articulated the core value: 'If we spend at different levels…what would happen? Against a synthetic audience, we can simulate it.' That simulation capability proves particularly valuable in scenarios where regional or product-line research data is 'usually quite limited.'

Beauty brand Sacheu is using Limitless Labs to build virtual focus groups from TikTok and Instagram creator posts to test marketing message variants. Havas participated in Vurvey Labs' $8.5 million Series A funding round, closed November 2025. Dentsu has maintained a relationship with Evidenza for media planning for over a year. WPP is using charitable donation data to drive programmatic media buys. Jellyfish and Code & Theory are leveraging an Adobe partnership to generate creative personas from client first-party and third-party data, applying them across the full pitch-to-production pipeline.

The industry is nonetheless candid about the technology's limitations. Goodway's Reynolds warns that LLMs default to 'the top of the bell curve — the most common answer,' making them liable to miss edge-case consumer insight; Vurvey's differentiator over pure-LLM solutions is precisely its ingestion of qualitative video survey data from real consumers. Hoffman stresses that synthetic tools 'inform judgment, but don't replace judgment,' while Clark cautions that personas built on non-proprietary data will produce unreliable outputs, and flags that agentic buying carries a budget concentration risk — potentially exhausting spend in a single day. The industry consensus is shifting from whether to adopt synthetic audiences to how to build a reliable enough data foundation to make them trustworthy.

items.title: Facebook 推出「Your Algorithm」：用戶以自然語言調控動態消息排序
items.title_en: Facebook Launches 'Your Algorithm': Users Reshape Feed and Reels Rankings with Natural Language
items.summary: 用戶可用文字描述偏好即時調整 Feed 與 Reels，廣告觸及邏輯將隨之改變
items.summary_en: Facebook's new 'Your Algorithm' tool lets users describe content preferences in plain language; LLMs process input in real time to reshape Feed and Reels recommendations, following similar rollouts on Instagram and Threads.
items.why: 用戶主動設定偏好，行為訊號權重下降，廣告創意相關性比以往更為關鍵
items.why_en: User-declared preferences may override behavioral targeting signals, making creative relevance more critical for paid performance.
highlights: 大型語言模型現已融入 Facebook 排名系統，解讀用戶自然語言偏好並即時調整推薦內容。
此功能繼 Instagram（2026 年 6 月）及 Threads（2026 年 2 月）之後在 Facebook 推出，Meta 正全平台推行用戶主控演算法。
用戶積極篩選內容後，與聲明偏好不符的廣告觸及率可能下滑，廣告主應密切監測成效波動。
highlights_en: LLMs are now embedded in Facebook's ranking system to interpret user natural language preferences and apply real-time feed adjustments.
Following Instagram in June 2026 and Threads in February 2026, 'Your Algorithm' marks a platform-wide Meta push toward user-controlled curation.
As users actively filter content, ads misaligned with stated preferences may see reduced reach; marketers should monitor campaign performance closely.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
items.detail:
Meta於2026年10月13日正式宣布在Facebook推出「Your Algorithm」功能，允許用戶以自然語言直接調控動態消息與Reels的內容排序邏輯。這是Facebook演算法透明度與用戶自主性的一次重大轉變——過去，演算法依靠數千個隱性行為信號（包括按讚、留言與影片觀看時長）自動推斷用戶偏好；現在，用戶可以主動告訴演算法自己想看什麼，或明確表達不感興趣的方向。

這套機制的底層由大型語言模型（LLM）驅動。Meta表示，LLM能夠理解自然語言背後的「興趣、情境與意圖」，從而將用戶的文字描述轉化為對推薦系統的具體調整指令。具體入口有兩處：其一是專屬的「Your Algorithm」管理面板，供用戶新增或管理針對動態消息與Reels的主題偏好；其二是強化版的回饋迴路，當用戶點擊「感興趣」或「不感興趣」後，系統可能進一步追問，由用戶以自己的語言補充說明。兩種路徑下的排序調整均為即時生效，不需要等到下一個瀏覽周期。

此次功能的推出，延續了Meta在2026年針對演算法透明度的一系列措施。在此之前，Meta於2026年5月12日宣布推出家長監督工具，允許家長了解青少年帳號的演算法推薦邏輯。兩項功能的共通立場，是將演算法的「可解釋性」與「可干預性」作為用戶關係的重要面向來處理。

從廣告主的角度而言，「Your Algorithm」帶來的影響具有雙重性。一方面，用戶主動宣告的興趣偏好可能比行為信號更精準，為興趣標籤的定向提供更清晰的輸入層；另一方面，若大量用戶主動過濾特定類型內容，既有的受眾分群邏輯可能需要重新評估。Meta在公告中未提及廣告投放的具體影響、功能的地理推送範圍，亦未討論用戶選擇調控偏好後對數據隱私的連帶影響。
items.detail_en:
Meta announced 'Your Algorithm' for Facebook on October 13, 2026, giving users the ability to directly shape the ranking logic of their Feed and Reels through natural language input. This marks a meaningful shift in how Facebook's recommendation system operates: rather than relying solely on thousands of implicit behavioral signals — likes, comments, watch time — the platform now allows users to explicitly declare preferences in their own words.

The underlying mechanism is powered by large language models. Meta states that LLMs can interpret the 'interests, context, and intent behind natural language,' translating a user's free-form text into concrete adjustments to the recommendation engine. There are two entry points: a dedicated 'Your Algorithm' panel where users can add and manage topic preferences for both Feed and Reels; and an enhanced feedback loop where clicking 'Interested' or 'Not interested' on a post may trigger a follow-up prompt, allowing users to elaborate conversationally. Both pathways update recommendations in real time, within the same browsing session.

The launch continues a series of algorithm transparency measures Meta has pursued through 2026. A prior announcement on May 12, 2026, introduced parental supervision tools giving parents visibility into the recommendation logic shaping their teenagers' accounts. Together, the two features reflect Meta's positioning of algorithm explainability and user controllability as cornerstones of its platform relationship strategy.

For advertisers, 'Your Algorithm' carries dual implications. User-declared interest preferences may provide a cleaner, more intentional signal layer than purely behavioral data, potentially sharpening interest-based targeting inputs. At the same time, if significant user segments begin actively filtering content categories, existing audience segmentation models built on passive behavioral inference may need to be reassessed. Meta's announcement does not specify the geographic rollout scope, address any downstream privacy implications of users actively disclosing preferences, or discuss how explicitly stated interests will interact with ad targeting parameters.

items.title: Google AI Overviews 測試處方藥廣告，搜尋版位邏輯進入新階段
items.title_en: Google AI Overviews Tests Prescription Drug Ads, Signaling New Search Monetization Phase
items.summary: Google 在 AI 生成摘要中嵌入處方藥廣告，搜尋廣告版位邏輯將根本改變
items.summary_en: Google is testing prescription drug ads within AI Overviews generated summaries, signaling active monetization of AI search results and a potential reshaping of ad placement logic for all categories.
items.why: AI 摘要廣告版位邏輯成形，行銷人需重新規劃搜尋預算配置
items.why_en: If AI Overviews monetization expands beyond pharma, search budget allocation and bidding strategy must be revisited.
highlights: Google 開始在 AI Overviews 生成式摘要區塊中測試處方藥廣告，是 AI 搜尋結果商業化的重要里程碑。
此舉預示未來將逐步擴展至其他產品類別，廣告主在 AI 摘要中的版位購買邏輯面臨根本性重組。
同期有報道指 Google 向競爭對手爬蟲注入錯誤數據，依賴第三方工具監測搜尋能見度的品牌應重新評估數據來源。
highlights_en: Google is testing prescription drug ads inside AI Overviews summary blocks — a significant milestone in commercializing AI search results.
The move suggests imminent expansion to other product categories, fundamentally reshaping how ad placement logic works within AI-generated answers.
Concurrently, reports that Google is feeding false data to competitor scrapers mean brands using third-party search tools should reassess data source reliability.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
items.detail:
Google 正在 AI Overviews 版位測試處方藥廣告投放，此舉標誌著搜尋廣告版位邏輯進入新階段。AI Overviews 是 Google 自 2024 年起大規模推出的 AI 生成摘要功能，在傳統藍色連結上方展示由語言模型彙整的答案頁面。過去，處方藥廣告受美國食品藥品監督管理局（FDA）嚴格規管，要求廣告須同等篇幅呈現風險資訊（即「fair balance」條款），而這在篇幅有限的 AI 摘要格式中如何執行，至今仍是業界待解難題。

AI Overviews 的廣告位置與傳統搜尋結果根本不同：前者是模型生成的內嵌答案，用戶往往不需要點擊外部連結即可獲取資訊，這使廣告曝光量與點擊率的計算邏輯需要重新定義。此前，Google 已在 AI Overviews 測試過非處方保健品、旅遊及金融類廣告，處方藥屬於監管敏感度最高的品類，此次測試是重要的邊界擴展。

從廣告主角度看，處方藥品牌過去依賴傳統搜尋關鍵字廣告觸達正在主動查詢病症或藥物的高意圖用戶，AI Overviews 則可能在用戶尚未形成明確藥品需求、僅在查詢症狀時便介入，觸達鏈路更前置。然而，AI 生成內容中植入藥品廣告若與摘要文字混淆，有可能引發合規與信任風險，廣告主與監管機構均需密切追蹤 Google 最終落地的格式設計與資訊揭露規範。

同一時期，Google 還被報道正向網路爬蟲工具注入錯誤數據，此舉影響 SEO 與 AEO 監測工具對品牌在搜尋結果中曝光位置的追蹤準確性，令廣告與自然流量的邊界更加模糊。兩項進展疊加，顯示 Google 正系統性地重塑搜尋廣告的版位規則、數據透明度與外部可監測性，對依賴第三方工具進行品牌監測的廣告主而言，現有追蹤方法論的可靠性值得重新評估。
items.detail_en:
Google is testing prescription drug advertisements within its AI Overviews feature, marking a significant evolution in search ad placement logic. AI Overviews, which Google rolled out at scale from 2024, displays AI-generated summary panels above traditional blue-link search results, synthesizing answers from multiple sources directly on the results page. Prescription drug advertising in the United States is governed by strict FDA regulations, including the "fair balance" requirement that mandates equal prominence for risk disclosures — a standard whose application within compact AI-generated formats remains an unresolved industry question.

The placement mechanics of AI Overviews differ fundamentally from traditional search results. Because users can often satisfy their information needs without clicking through to external sites, standard click-through metrics and impression accounting must be redefined. Google has previously tested ads within AI Overviews for categories including over-the-counter health products, travel, and financial services; prescription drugs represent the highest-sensitivity regulatory category yet to be tested, making this a meaningful boundary expansion.

For pharmaceutical advertisers, the shift carries strategic implications beyond compliance. Traditional search keyword ads capture users with explicit drug-name intent. AI Overviews could intercept consumers earlier in the decision journey — at the symptom-query stage, before brand or product intent has formed — potentially expanding reach but also raising questions about appropriate context. If ads appear intermingled with AI-generated medical summaries without clear visual differentiation, both regulatory compliance and consumer trust could be at risk.

Concurrently, Google has been reported to be injecting false data into responses served to web scraper bots, undermining the accuracy of SEO and Answer Engine Optimization tools that brands use to monitor their search visibility. Together, these two developments suggest a systemic reshaping of search advertising's placement rules, data transparency, and external auditability — circumstances that warrant a reassessment of the reliability of third-party monitoring methodologies for any advertiser relying on them to measure brand presence in search.

items.title: 字節跳動發布世界模型：文字一鍵生成可互動 3D 空間
items.title_en: ByteDance Debuts World Model: Text Prompts Generate Explorable 3D Interactive Environments
items.summary: 抖音集團技術秀場展示世界模型，從文字生成物理可互動的三維空間
items.summary_en: At its 2026 Wonder Night showcase, ByteDance demonstrated a world model generating interactive 3D environments from text — enabling free exploration, real-time object creation, and physics simulation, moving AI generation from content to persistent digital worlds.
items.why: 品牌可用文字指令生成可探索的 3D 產品展示空間，視覺製作成本大幅降低
items.why_en: Brands could generate explorable 3D campaign environments from a text brief alone, dramatically cutting visual production costs.
highlights: 世界模型不只生成圖像，而是建立可持續存在、可自由探索的數字空間，物理規則與物件互動均有模擬。
字節跳動展示駕駛場景模擬與機器人家居訓練等應用，顯示技術已超越單純視覺內容生成。
英偉達 Cosmos 與 AMD 收購的 World Labs 同步布局，世界模型正快速進入工業化階段。
highlights_en: World models create persistent, explorable digital spaces with physics simulation and object interaction, going far beyond static image or video generation.
ByteDance demonstrated driving scenario simulation and household robot training, signaling applications far beyond consumer content creation.
With NVIDIA Cosmos and World Labs (acquired by AMD for $8.2B) moving in parallel, world model technology is industrializing rapidly.
items.detail:
字節跳動在 2026 年「抖音集團美好奇妙夜」技術展示活動上，正式亮相其世界模型（World Model）成果，展示文字輸入一鍵生成可互動三維空間的能力。用戶只需輸入一段文字描述，系統便可生成一個以俯瞰縮微視角呈現的三維房間場景，並允許用戶以鍵盤與滑鼠自由飛行穿梭其中，而非僅觀看靜態渲染圖像。

此次展示涵蓋三項核心技術能力。第一是空間表徵（Spatial Representation），系統在用戶探索過程中持續維持場景的幾何一致性，避免視角移動時出現物件錯位或空間崩塌。第二是環境狀態建模與動態預測（Environment State Modeling and Dynamic Prediction），系統可即時追蹤場景內物件之間的相對位置與物理關係；展示中，用戶能憑空召喚一把湯匙並與其產生物理互動，系統即時計算物件運動軌跡。第三是跨場景連續性（Cross-Scene Continuity），展示了名為「任意門」的功能——系統可在語義上毫無關聯的兩個場景（例如一間室內房間與外太空環境）之間建立無縫銜接通道，使用戶能跨越空間邊界連續探索。

從技術溯源看，字節跳動此前推出的影片生成模型 Seedance 2.5 在空間一致性與可控編輯方面積累了大量工程經驗，圖像生成模型 Seedream 5.0 Pro 則在場景細節渲染上提供支撐，兩者共同構成世界模型的基礎能力底座。世界模型本質上要求系統不僅能生成單幀圖像，更需理解並模擬三維空間中物理規律的演變，這在計算複雜度上遠高於傳統圖像或影片生成任務。

截至發布時，該世界模型尚未對外正式開放，字節跳動未公布具體的商業化計劃或開放時間表。業界普遍認為，具備互動能力的世界模型若走向成熟，將在遊戲關卡設計、虛擬實境內容製作、建築與空間可視化以及具身智能（Embodied AI）訓練數據生成等領域帶來結構性應用機遇，對行銷業而言，虛擬場景的低成本快速生成亦可能顛覆現有的廣告拍攝與場景製作流程。
items.detail_en:
ByteDance unveiled its World Model at the 2026 Douyin Group tech showcase, demonstrating the ability to generate interactive, explorable three-dimensional spaces from a single text prompt. The system produces a miniature-perspective 3D room scene from a text description and allows users to freely navigate through it using keyboard and mouse, going well beyond static rendered images or video playback.

The demonstration highlighted three core technical capabilities. First, Spatial Representation: the system maintains geometric consistency throughout user exploration, preventing object misalignment or spatial incoherence as the viewpoint shifts. Second, Environment State Modeling and Dynamic Prediction: the system tracks real-time physical relationships between objects within the scene. In the live demo, users could summon objects — such as a spoon — and physically interact with them, with the system computing motion trajectories in real time. Third, Cross-Scene Continuity: a feature named the "Magic Door" (任意門) creates seamless transition portals between semantically unrelated scenes — for instance, connecting an indoor room to outer space — enabling continuous cross-boundary exploration.

Technically, the World Model builds on foundations established by ByteDance's prior generative AI work. The video generation model Seedance 2.5 contributed spatial consistency and controllable editing capabilities, while the image generation model Seedream 5.0 Pro provided detailed scene rendering. Together these underpin the spatial and temporal coherence demands of a world model, which requires simulating physical rule evolution across a 3D environment rather than merely generating individual frames.

As of the announcement, the World Model has not been publicly released, and ByteDance has not disclosed a commercialization timeline. Industry observers note that if interactive world models reach production maturity, they could unlock structural applications in game level design, VR content production, architectural visualization, and embodied AI training data generation. For the marketing industry specifically, the ability to rapidly generate virtual environments at low cost could reshape advertising production workflows, reducing reliance on physical set construction and location shoots.

items.title: MiniCPM-V 4.7 開源：35B 多模態模型僅佔 3GB 記憶體，iPhone 離線運行
items.title_en: MiniCPM-V 4.7 Open-Sourced: 35B Multimodal Model Runs Offline on iPhone with Just 3GB RAM
items.summary: 面壁智能開源 MiniCPM-V 4.7，採 MoE 架構實現高端多模態能力在手機端離線運行
items.summary_en: ModelBest open-sourced MiniCPM-V 4.7, using a mixture-of-experts architecture to run a 35B multimodal model on just 3GB RAM — enabling offline OCR, chart analysis, and document extraction on iPhone 17 Pro Max at 13+ tokens per second.
items.why: 廣告代理可在無網路環境本地處理客戶簡報與合約，敏感資料無需上傳雲端
items.why_en: Ad agencies can analyze client briefs, contracts, and creative assets locally with zero cloud exposure, enabling privacy-first AI workflows on existing devices.
highlights: MiniCPM-V 4.7 在 OmniDocBench v1.6 文件解析基準測試中得分 94.24，領先競品逾 12 分。
35B-A3B 版本採用混合專家架構，每次推理僅啟用約 3B 參數，使 iPhone 17 Pro Max 可在 3GB 記憶體內完整運行。
「Self-Replay 微調」技術允許團隊針對品牌特定任務調整模型，同時保留通用能力，降低定制 AI 部署門檻。
highlights_en: MiniCPM-V 4.7 scored 94.24 on OmniDocBench v1.6, outperforming competitors by more than 12 points on document parsing.
The 35B-A3B version uses a mixture-of-experts architecture activating only ~3B parameters per inference, fitting within 3GB RAM on iPhone 17 Pro Max.
'Self-Replay Fine-Tuning' lets teams adapt the model to brand-specific tasks while preserving general capabilities, lowering the bar for custom on-device AI.
items.detail:
面壁智能（ModelBest）與 OpenBMB 聯合發布開源多模態模型 MiniCPM-V 4.7，提供兩個版本供選擇：35B-A3B 版本採用混合專家架構（Mixture of Experts，MoE），名義參數量達 350 億，每次推理僅激活約 30 億個活躍參數，記憶體佔用壓縮至約 3GB；另一版本為 1.3B 的全激活小型模型，適合資源極為有限的場景。35B-A3B 版本已通過實測，可在 iPhone 17 Pro Max 上實現每秒超過 13 個 token 的離線推理速度，無需連接網路或雲端伺服器。

模型在多項權威基準測試中取得領先成績。在 MMBench 上得分 91.72，在衡量多學科理解能力的 MMMU 測試上達到 80.22，在文件理解基準 OmniDocBench v1.6 上取得 94.24 分，較競爭對手領先超過 12 個百分點，顯示其在複雜版面文件的 OCR 與結構化理解方面具備顯著優勢。在 iPad Pro M4 上的測試則顯示解碼速度較上一代提升五倍。

支撐上述性能的核心技術包含三項創新。「前瞻專家調度」（Look-ahead Expert Scheduling，LES）技術在當前層計算的同時預測下一層所需的專家模組，實現超過 80% 的預取命中率，顯著降低 MoE 架構的推理延遲；混合精度量化（Mixed-Precision Quantization）對不同層的專家權重分別施以差異化壓縮策略，在縮減模型體積的同時保留精度敏感層的表示能力；「自我回放微調」（Self-Replay Fine-Tuning）則針對模型在針對特定任務進行客製化訓練時容易遺忘原有通用能力的問題，設計了知識保留機制。

相容性方面，MiniCPM-V 4.7 支援 iOS、Android 與鴻蒙（HarmonyOS）三大移動平台，並相容 SGLang、vLLM、llama.cpp 及 Ollama 等主流推理框架，開發者可依需求選用。對廣告與行銷產業而言，在終端裝置離線運行的多模態模型意味著圖像內容理解、受眾行為分析與個人化內容生成可在不將用戶數據上傳至雲端的前提下完成，為合規敏感場景（如金融、醫療、企業內網）的 AI 應用開闢新的部署路徑。
items.detail_en:
ModelBest and OpenBMB jointly released MiniCPM-V 4.7, an open-source multimodal model available in two variants. The flagship 35B-A3B version uses a Mixture of Experts (MoE) architecture with a nominal 35 billion parameters, but activates only approximately 3 billion parameters per inference token, compressing memory usage to around 3GB. A 1.3B fully-activated variant is also available for extremely resource-constrained deployments. The 35B-A3B version has been validated running fully offline on an iPhone 17 Pro Max at over 13 tokens per second, requiring no internet or cloud server connection.

The model achieves competitive results on major benchmarks. It scores 91.72 on MMBench, 80.22 on MMMU (which evaluates multi-discipline understanding), and 94.24 on OmniDocBench v1.6 — outperforming competitors by more than 12 points on the document understanding benchmark. Testing on an iPad Pro M4 demonstrated a 5x decoding speed improvement versus the prior generation.

Three technical innovations underpin this performance profile. Look-ahead Expert Scheduling (LES) predicts which expert modules the next transformer layer will require while the current layer is still computing, achieving over 80% prefetch accuracy and substantially reducing the inference latency inherent to MoE architectures. Mixed-precision quantization applies differentiated weight compression strategies layer by layer, preserving representation fidelity in precision-sensitive layers while aggressively compressing others to minimize model size. Self-Replay Fine-Tuning addresses the well-documented capability forgetting problem that occurs when models are fine-tuned for specific tasks, implementing a knowledge-retention mechanism that preserves general capabilities during customization.

The model supports iOS, Android, and HarmonyOS, and is compatible with SGLang, vLLM, llama.cpp, and Ollama inference frameworks. For the advertising and marketing industry, on-device multimodal inference without cloud data transmission opens deployment paths for image content understanding, audience behavior analysis, and personalized content generation in compliance-sensitive contexts — including financial services, healthcare, and enterprise intranets — where uploading user data to external servers is restricted or prohibited.

items.title: 百事可樂無競標直接轉投陽獅，三十年奧美關係告終
items.title_en: PepsiCo Moves $1.9B Media Account to Publicis Without a Pitch, Ending 30-Year Omnicom Relationship
items.summary: PepsiCo 以「數據精細度」為由，未經比稿直接將約 19 億美元全球媒體預算轉至陽獅集團
items.summary_en: PepsiCo ended a 30-year Omnicom relationship without a formal pitch, moving its estimated $1.9B global media account to Publicis Groupe, with CEO citing superior data granularity as the deciding factor.
items.why: 數據能力正取代創意執行成為客戶選擇代理商的首要標準
items.why_en: Data capability is replacing creative execution as the primary criterion for client agency selection — a structural shift for the industry.
highlights: PepsiCo 在未舉行正式比稿的情況下終止與奧美長達 30 年的合作，直接委任陽獅集團。
陽獅集團越過 CMO 層級直接向 CEO 層面呈現數據能力，改寫傳統新業務開發路徑。
可口可樂據報已就北美業務展開內部評估，奧美與電通均在洽談之列，顯示連鎖效應正在蔓延。
highlights_en: PepsiCo terminated a 30-year Omnicom relationship without a formal pitch, directly appointing Publicis Groupe.
Publicis pitched directly to the CEO level, bypassing CMOs — reshaping how agencies develop new business.
Coca-Cola is reportedly reviewing its North American account, with Omnicom and Dentsu in talks, signaling a wider industry ripple effect.

items.detail:
百事可樂（PepsiCo）在未舉行任何公開競標的情況下，將全球媒體採購業務直接轉移至陽獅集團（Publicis Groupe），終結與宏盟集團（Omnicom）長達三十年的代理關係。根據媒體研究公司 COMvergence 的估算，百事可樂全球年度媒體投放規模約達 19 億美元（約 148 億港幣），其中北美市場佔約 7.8 億美元，是廣告業近年罕見的超大型賬戶直接轉移案例。

百事可樂首席執行官 Ramon Laguarta 在財報電話會議上親自為此次決策背書，形容陽獅是「對我們而言一項重要能力」，並承諾雙方合作將帶來「更豐富的數據、更精細的顆粒度」。行銷業界分析人士留意到，如此重大的代理商轉換決策通常由首席行銷官主導，由 CEO 在財報公開場合主動表態是高度罕見的信號，顯示百事可樂正將廣告採購從標準運營成本重新定位為核心戰略槓桿。

此次轉換的背景是百事可樂北美業務近年面臨連續提價後銷量下滑的壓力，管理層需要更具精準性的媒體投資來支撐品牌復甦。陽獅集團近年在第一方數據整合與程序化購買能力上持續加碼，旗下 Epsilon 數據平台被視為其差異化優勢的核心資產，亦是吸引百事可樂的關鍵因素之一。

賬戶移動引發的連鎖反應已開始浮現。可口可樂（Coca-Cola）此前剛從 WPP 手中轉投陽獅，如今正重新審視其北美媒體賬戶，據報正與宏盟及電通（Dentsu）接洽。業界普遍預期，隨著持股集團整合浪潮持續，大型品牌在代理商選擇上愈來愈傾向以數據能力與技術平台整合程度作為首要評估維度，傳統創意服務在賬戶競爭中的議價空間受到進一步壓縮。
items.detail_en:
PepsiCo transferred its global media buying account to Publicis Groupe without holding any formal competitive pitch, ending a three-decade relationship with Omnicom Group. According to estimates from media research firm COMvergence, PepsiCo's annual global media spend totals approximately $1.9 billion, with around $780 million attributable to North America alone — making this one of the largest direct account transfers in the advertising industry in recent years.

PepsiCo CEO Ramon Laguarta personally endorsed the decision on an earnings call, describing Publicis as "an important capability for us" and promising the partnership would deliver "much more data, much more granularity." Industry analysts noted that account switches of this magnitude are typically championed by the Chief Marketing Officer, not the CEO; Laguarta's direct and public endorsement on an investor call is an unusually strong signal that PepsiCo is repositioning advertising investment from a standard operating cost to a core strategic lever under his direct ownership.

The switch comes as PepsiCo's North America business faces volume declines following years of consumer price increases. Management requires more precisely targeted media investment to support brand recovery. Publicis has invested heavily in first-party data integration and programmatic buying capabilities, with its Epsilon data platform widely regarded as a key differentiating asset — a significant factor in attracting the account away from Omnicom.

The ripple effects are already visible. Coca-Cola, which had recently moved to Publicis from WPP, is now reviewing its North American media account and reportedly in discussions with Omnicom and Dentsu. The broader industry expectation is that as holdco consolidation continues, large brands will increasingly evaluate agency partners primarily on data capability and technology platform integration — further compressing the competitive leverage of traditional creative services in major account competitions.

items.title: ADK 與 Stagwell 簽訂三年全球戰略夥伴協議，以 AI 推動日本 IP 全球化
items.title_en: ADK and Stagwell Formalize Three-Year Global Partnership, Using AI to Take Japanese IP Worldwide
items.summary: ADK Holdings 與 Stagwell 正式確立三年戰略夥伴關係，結合 Machine OS AI 平台推動日本 IP 全球化
items.summary_en: ADK Holdings and Stagwell formalized a three-year strategic partnership combining ADK's Japan expertise with Stagwell's Machine OS AI platform to expand Japanese IP globally and help international brands enter Japan.
items.why: 日本 IP 全球擴張為亞太區代理商帶來跨境業務機會
items.why_en: Japanese IP global expansion creates cross-border business opportunities for APAC agencies to pursue or compete against.
highlights: 合作建立於 2025 年 7 月的合作備忘錄之上，經約一年聯合項目測試後正式深化為三年協議。
核心方向為將日本 IP 版權推向北美等全球市場，並協助國際品牌進入日本，結合 ADK 本地洞察與 Stagwell Media 的 AI 媒介購買平台。
此次合作為亞太區代理商的跨境聯盟模式提供了「先測試、後正式化」的可參考框架。
highlights_en: The partnership builds on a July 2025 MOU, formalized after roughly one year of joint project testing.
The focus is expanding Japanese IP into global markets (starting North America) and helping international brands enter Japan, combining ADK's local expertise with Stagwell Media's AI buying platform.
The 'test first, then formalize' approach offers a replicable framework for APAC agencies building cross-border alliances.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例
items.detail:
ADK Marketing Solutions（ADK控股旗下核心行銷公司）與全球行銷網絡Stagwell於2026年10月13日正式宣布簽訂為期三年的全球主協議（Master Agreement），將雙方合作關係由單一項目合作升級為長期戰略框架。此前兩家公司於2025年7月簽訂意向備忘錄（MOU），並經過約一年的聯合項目測試後，確認合作方向足以支撐更深層的制度性安排。

協議的核心聚焦兩個業務方向：其一是推動日本IP的全球化，初期重點市場鎖定北美，由ADK負責IP運營，Stagwell則提供其在美國的數據分析能力與代理商網絡；其二是協助國際品牌進入日本市場，雙方聯合制定本地化行銷策略。除項目合作外，協議亦涵蓋人員互換機制，以及數據、工具與行銷解決方案的跨網絡共享使用。

ADK Marketing Solutions執行副總裁（全球行銷）末松正人表示，過去一年的合作已建立起充分的互信基礎，使雙方有信心推進至更正式的戰略框架。Stagwell亞太區董事總經理Randy Duax則強調，「ADK對日本市場擁有無可比擬的深度理解，而Stagwell帶來的是一個專為透過AI轉化行銷而建立的全球網絡」——這句話直接點明AI能力是Stagwell在此合作中的核心貢獻。

從行業背景看，日本動漫、遊戲、虛擬偶像等IP在近年全球市場持續升溫，但日本廣告公司長期以來在本土以外缺乏規模化分銷與行銷基礎設施。此次ADK選擇借助Stagwell在北美的AI數據工具與媒體購買網絡切入，而非自建海外架構，反映的是日本廣告業正在重新評估全球化路徑的更廣泛趨勢。協議財務條款未予披露。
items.detail_en:
ADK Marketing Solutions, the core marketing arm of ADK Holdings, and global marketing network Stagwell formally announced a three-year Master Agreement on October 13, 2026, elevating their relationship from project-based cooperation to a long-term strategic framework. The two companies had signed a Memorandum of Understanding in July 2025, and after roughly one year of joint project collaboration, both sides determined the partnership was strong enough to warrant a more institutionalized structure.

The agreement is organized around two primary business directions. The first is globalizing Japanese intellectual property, with North America as the initial target market: ADK leads IP operations while Stagwell contributes its U.S. data analytics capabilities and agency network. The second is supporting international brands entering Japan, where both parties will jointly develop localized marketing strategies. Beyond project collaboration, the agreement includes structured personnel exchanges and shared access to data, tools, and marketing solutions across both networks.

ADK Marketing Solutions Executive Vice President of Global Marketing Masato Suematsu stated that the prior year of collaboration had built sufficient mutual trust to move toward a more formal strategic framework. Stagwell APAC Managing Director Randy Duax described the partnership's logic directly: 'ADK brings an unmatched understanding of Japan...while Stagwell brings a global network built to transform marketing through AI.' This framing positions Stagwell's AI capabilities as its central contribution to the deal.

The strategic context is significant. Japanese anime, gaming, and virtual talent IP has seen sustained global demand growth, yet Japanese advertising agencies have historically lacked the scaled distribution infrastructure and marketing tooling needed outside Japan. ADK's choice to partner with Stagwell's North American AI data and media buying network — rather than building its own international structure — reflects a broader reassessment of globalization pathways within Japan's advertising industry. Financial terms of the agreement were not disclosed.

items.title: OpenAI 以面對面活動行銷 ChatGPT 企業版，最有效渠道不是數字廣告
items.title_en: OpenAI Bets on Field Marketing for Enterprise ChatGPT Sales: In-Person Events Beat Digital Ads
items.summary: OpenAI EMEA 行銷主管揭示，品牌知名度高不等於企業購買，高接觸銷售模式更有效
items.summary_en: OpenAI's EMEA B2B marketing head reveals field events are its top-performing enterprise channel; ChatGPT brand awareness doesn't automatically convert to enterprise buying, requiring high-touch, regionally nuanced strategies.
items.why: AI 工具 B2B 行銷揭示高客單價採購的渠道優先序，對推廣自身服務有參考價值
items.why_en: OpenAI's channel mix reveals complex B2B AI sales still require in-person trust-building — a lesson for any agency pitching AI-led services.
highlights: OpenAI EMEA B2B 行銷主管 Leila Woodington 指出，面對面活動是企業採購 ChatGPT 的最高效渠道，因決策鏈複雜，單一渠道無法說服大型企業高管。
OpenAI 採用精選 KOL 合作（限真實使用產品的創作者）、每月約兩場網路研討會，以及本地語言行銷團隊推進各市場滲透。
Instagram 贊助貼文數量由 6 月的 61 篇增至 7 月的 122 篇，顯示品牌知名度層面仍加大數字廣告投入。
highlights_en: OpenAI EMEA B2B marketing head Leila Woodington identifies in-person field events as the top enterprise conversion channel, with no single channel able to persuade Fortune 500 executives alone.
OpenAI's mix includes creator partnerships limited to genuine product users, ~2 webinars per month, and local-language regional teams for market penetration.
Instagram sponsored posts doubled from 61 in June to 122 in July, showing continued digital investment for brand awareness even as field events drive enterprise conversion.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例
items.detail:
OpenAI負責EMEA地區B2B行銷的主管Leila Woodington在近期接受採訪時明確點出：在銷售ChatGPT企業版的所有渠道中，面對面活動行銷（Field Marketing）是「我現在肯定會作為最強渠道推出的一個」。Woodington此前在Facebook深耕B2B行銷超過十年，並歷經Snap及一家AI影片初創公司後，於一年多前加入OpenAI，負責建立其歐洲、中東及非洲的企業市場行銷職能。

Woodington解釋了面對面活動行銷在企業銷售中不可被數字廣告取代的結構性原因：消費者層面的品牌知名度，與企業採購決策之間存在明顯落差。一家大型企業的高管即便熟知ChatGPT產品，也並不因此清楚如何在數千名員工中部署它，或如何說服多個層級的決策者通過採購。這種複雜的購買決策鏈條，需要人與人之間的直接互動才能有效推進。

在執行層面，OpenAI的行銷團隊採用預定義的活動日曆，而非針對每次新產品發布從零建立獨立行銷活動。以上個月在舊金山發布的持久AI代理產品Dots為例，推廣工作直接嵌入既有的活動框架中進行。除面對面活動外，團隊每月舉辦約兩場定期網路研討會（Webinar），並與「精心篩選」的真實使用產品的創作者合作進行影響力行銷。Instagram贊助貼文數量亦由2026年6月的61條增至7月的122條，增幅翻倍。

Woodington坦承一個有趣的矛盾：企業客戶的CMO期待她精通OpenAI所有工具，而她自己的團隊卻面臨與其他人同樣的跟進壓力——「我們也在嘗試以與其他人相同的方式追趕最新進展。」這一承認揭示了AI產品行銷的特殊困境：行銷者本身也是快速迭代產品的使用者與學習者，而非僅僅是傳播者。
items.detail_en:
Leila Woodington, OpenAI's Head of B2B Marketing for EMEA, has identified in-person field marketing as 'the one I would definitely put out as our strongest channel right now' among all channels used to sell ChatGPT Enterprise. Woodington spent over a decade building Facebook's B2B marketing function before moving through roles at Snap and an AI video startup, then joined OpenAI more than a year ago to build its enterprise marketing capability across Europe, the Middle East, and Africa.

Woodington explained the structural reason why field marketing cannot be replaced by digital advertising in enterprise sales: there is a meaningful gap between consumer-level brand awareness and actual enterprise purchasing decisions. Even a Fortune 500 executive who is familiar with ChatGPT as a product does not automatically know how to deploy it across thousands of employees or how to persuade multiple layers of executive decision-makers. That complex buying process requires direct human interaction to advance effectively.

Operationally, the OpenAI marketing team uses a predefined activity calendar rather than building fresh campaigns for each product launch. When the persistent AI agent product Dots launched last month in San Francisco, its promotion was plugged into existing campaign frameworks rather than requiring a standalone build. Beyond field events, the team runs approximately two webinars per month on a fixed schedule and works with 'carefully curated' influencer and creator partners who genuinely use the products. Instagram sponsored posts doubled from 61 in June 2026 to 122 in July, according to Business Insider data.

Woodington acknowledged a notable tension: enterprise CMOs expect her to have mastered every OpenAI tool, yet her own team faces the same pace challenge as any other organization — 'we are trying to keep up in the same way as others.' This admission surfaces a specific difficulty in AI product marketing: the marketers themselves are simultaneously users and learners of a rapidly iterating product, not merely its communicators.

items.title: 品牌被 AI 引用的實戰手冊：Flo 與 Motorway 的 GEO 策略拆解
items.title_en: How Brands Get Cited by AI: Flo Health and Motorway's GEO Playbook Unpacked
items.summary: 兩大品牌分享讓 AI 搜尋引擎引用自家內容的具體策略，包括即時監測與專職 GEO 人員
items.summary_en: At Semrush Spotlight London, Flo Health and Motorway shared live tactics for Generative Engine Optimization: real-time LLM monitoring, dedicated GEO staffing, and testing ChatGPT paid placements to increase AI citation rates.
items.why: 全球每十次搜尋已有一次在 AI 工具發生，GEO 成代理商必須掌握的新技能
items.why_en: With roughly 1-in-10 global searches now on AI tools, GEO is becoming a billable skill agencies must build urgently.
highlights: Motorway 即時追蹤大型語言模型輸出，發布新內容後最快 24 小時可觀察到被 AI 引用，並已在英國測試 ChatGPT 廣告投放（2026 年 5 月啟動）。
Flo Health 聘請專職「LLM 能見度經理」，負責在媒體規劃及訊息開發的每個環節協調跨渠道一致性。
有效的 GEO 需整合三個層面：即時監測 AI 引用情況、將 AI 能見度責任歸屬於特定角色，以及測試 AI 平台的付費廣告產品。
highlights_en: Motorway tracks LLM outputs in real time and sees new content cited by AI within 24 hours of publication; it is already testing ChatGPT ads in the UK, launched May 2026.
Flo Health hired a dedicated LLM discoverability manager who collaborates across every channel during media planning and messaging development.
Effective GEO requires three layers: real-time AI citation monitoring, assigned ownership of LLM discoverability, and testing paid placements on AI answer platforms.
items.detail:
在2026年10月13日於倫敦舉行的Semrush Spotlight活動上，女性健康應用程式Flo Health與二手車交易平台Motorway分別披露了各自在生成式引擎優化（GEO，Generative Engine Optimization）上的實戰策略，為品牌如何被ChatGPT、Perplexity等AI工具主動引用提供了具體的操作案例。

Motorway行銷與品牌總監Cassie Hall介紹了一套即時追蹤機制：公司持續監控各大語言模型的輸出結果，以識別品牌在哪些查詢場景中被引用、在哪些場景中缺席。Hall表示，「我們可以發布新內容，並在24小時內看到它被引用」——這一週期遠短於傳統SEO見效的數週乃至數月周期，反映出語言模型爬取與更新索引的頻率已接近實時。Motorway亦在測試ChatGPT廣告功能，該功能已於2026年5月在英國市場推出，成為另一條觸達AI生成答案用戶的付費路徑。

Flo Health的策略側重於組織架構的調整，而非單純的內容技術優化。品牌行銷主管Georgia Jones透露，公司已專門聘用一名「語言模型可發現性」（LLM Discoverability）管理人員，該職位的職責橫跨所有渠道，在制定媒體計劃與信息架構時同步介入。這一設計的邏輯是：AI引用的核心驅動因素是跨渠道的品牌信息一致性，而非任何單一頁面的技術優化。若同一品牌在不同平台傳遞的信息存在矛盾，語言模型在生成引用時會傾向選擇信息更清晰、更具權威性的競爭對手。

Microsoft Advertising EMEA地區銷售副總裁Helena Dillon亦出席了此次活動。整體來看，兩個案例共同指向GEO的實操核心：品牌需要建立可驗證的信息一致性基礎設施，並將AI引用視為一個可測量、可優化的渠道，而非被動等待語言模型自發學習。
items.detail_en:
At the Semrush Spotlight event in London on October 13, 2026, women's health app Flo Health and used car trading platform Motorway separately disclosed their practical strategies for generative engine optimization (GEO) — the discipline of getting brands cited by AI tools such as ChatGPT and Perplexity.

Motorway Marketing and Brand Director Cassie Hall described a real-time tracking mechanism: the company continuously monitors large language model outputs to identify in which query scenarios the brand is cited and where it is absent. Hall stated, 'We can publish new content and see it being cited within 24 hours' — a cycle far shorter than the weeks or months traditional SEO typically requires, reflecting the fact that language model crawling and index updating now operates close to real time. Motorway is also testing ChatGPT ads, which launched in the U.K. in May 2026, providing a paid pathway to reach users engaging with AI-generated answers.

Flo Health's strategy centers on organizational restructuring rather than purely technical content optimization. Head of Brand Marketing Georgia Jones revealed that the company has hired a dedicated LLM Discoverability manager whose remit spans every channel, with involvement at the point where media plans and messaging frameworks are developed. The underlying logic is that the primary driver of AI citations is brand message consistency across touchpoints, not technical optimization on any single page. Where a brand delivers contradictory information across platforms, language models generating citations will tend to favor competitors whose messaging is clearer and more authoritative.

Microsoft Advertising EMEA Regional VP of Sales Helena Dillon also participated in the event. Together, the two cases point toward a shared operational principle for GEO: brands need to build verifiable message consistency infrastructure and treat AI citation as a measurable, optimizable channel — rather than passively waiting for language models to learn about them on their own.

items.title: Google Demand Gen 十月更新：推出數據強度提升指標並擴展 Data Manager
items.title_en: Google Demand Gen October Drop: Data Strength Uplift Metric Launches, Data Manager Expands to DV360
items.summary: Google 推出數據強度提升指標，Tag Gateway 用戶平均轉換增幅達 20%
items.summary_en: Google's October Demand Gen update introduces a Data Strength Uplift metric in Google Ads, expands Data Manager to DV360 and Google Analytics, and brings Enhanced Conversions to both — with Tag Gateway users seeing 20%+ conversion uplift on average.
items.why: 首次可在 Google Ads 介面直接量化第一方數據投資的轉換回報
items.why_en: First time advertisers can quantify how much first-party data setup lifts conversion volume directly in-platform.
highlights: 新的「數據強度提升」指標讓廣告主無需離開 Google Ads 介面即可量化第一方數據配置帶來的轉換增益。
Data Manager 功能擴展至 Display & Video 360 與 Google Analytics，實現跨平台第一方數據統一管理。
保險平台 The Zebra 在實施數據強度最佳實踐後，轉換量提升 16%、整體轉換價值提升 19%。
highlights_en: The new Data Strength Uplift metric lets advertisers quantify conversion gains from first-party data setup without leaving the Google Ads interface.
Data Manager is expanding to Display & Video 360 and Google Analytics, enabling unified first-party data management across Google's ecosystem.
Insurance platform The Zebra achieved 16% more conversions and 19% higher conversion value after implementing data strength best practices.
items.detail:
Google於2026年10月13日發布第14期Demand Gen Drop，推出數項以「數據強度」（Data Strength）為核心概念的功能更新，核心目標是讓廣告主能夠量化其第一方數據配置對廣告成效的實際貢獻，並將這套數據基礎設施延伸至更廣泛的Google生態系平台。

最具代表性的新功能是「數據強度提升指標」（Data Strength Uplift Metric），即將在Google Ads介面中上線。這項指標將直接向廣告主顯示，其當前的數據配置——包括轉換追蹤、客戶比對（Customer Match）及增強型轉換（Enhanced Conversions）等設置——在Demand Gen廣告系列中帶來了多少額外轉換提升，使廣告主能夠以更直觀的方式評估數據投資的回報。配套發布的還有更新版《數據強度最佳實踐指南》，提供可操作的配置步驟。

在基礎設施層面，Google宣布將Data Manager功能擴展至Display & Video 360（DV360）及Google Analytics，增強型轉換亦將隨後在這兩個平台上線。此前Data Manager主要在Google Ads原生環境中提供，此次擴展意味著廣告主可在程序化購買與分析平台中使用相同的第一方數據管理框架。Google內部分析數據（以2026年6月3日至17日為研究窗口）顯示，採用Google Tag Gateway的廣告主在Demand Gen廣告系列中平均可見超過20%的轉換提升。

美國保險比價平台The Zebra提供了一個具體的實際案例：在實施數據強度優化後，該平台實現了16%的轉換量增長，以及19%的整體轉換價值增長。這兩項數字成為Google此次更新的主要對外背書依據。整體而言，此次更新的方向是將第一方數據配置從技術合規事項重新定義為可量化的廣告績效槓桿。

Google published its 14th Demand Gen Drop on October 13, 2026, releasing several updates centered on the concept of 'data strength' — with the core objective of enabling advertisers to quantify the actual contribution of their first-party data configuration to campaign performance, and extending that data infrastructure framework to a broader set of Google ecosystem platforms.

The most substantive new feature is the Data Strength Uplift Metric, set to launch in the Google Ads interface. This metric will show advertisers directly how much additional conversion uplift their current data configuration — including conversion tracking, Customer Match, and Enhanced Conversions setup — is generating within Demand Gen campaigns, giving them a more intuitive way to evaluate the return on their data investments. A refreshed Data Strength Best Practices Guide with actionable configuration steps was released alongside the feature.

At the infrastructure level, Google announced the expansion of Data Manager to Display & Video 360 (DV360) and Google Analytics, with Enhanced Conversions also coming to both platforms in the near term. Previously, Data Manager was primarily available within the native Google Ads environment; this expansion means advertisers can apply the same first-party data management framework within programmatic buying and analytics platforms. Google internal analysis — using a study window of June 3 to 17, 2026 — found that advertisers using Google Tag Gateway see an average of over 20% conversion uplift in Demand Gen campaigns.

U.S. insurance comparison platform The Zebra provided a concrete real-world reference point: after implementing data strength optimizations, the platform achieved a 16% increase in conversion volume and a 19% increase in overall conversion value. Both figures serve as the primary external proof points for Google's update announcement. Taken together, the direction of this update is to reframe first-party data configuration from a technical compliance matter into a quantifiable performance lever within advertising campaigns.
